functions.name: KATEX
functions.description: Renders a LaTeX mathematical equation locally via KaTeX into an in-cell image or floating shape.

parameters.name: latexString
parameters.description: The LaTeX mathematical formula string to render (e.g. '\frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}').

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Background color code: 0 or 'transparent' (default), 1 or 'white', 2 or 'black'.
